capabilities: insert video cards from pasted Bilibili links via context menu or command palette
create UP-owner cards with avatar, nickname, follower count and optional featured video
batch-import links one per line, skipping failed fetches
edit card galleries in an embedded CodeMirror source view with add, sort and revert-to-link actions
adjust card layout, aspect ratio, spacing and fonts from the settings panel
extras: The README is primarily in Chinese with an English summary; cards degrade to plain links in environments without the plugin.
problem: Pasted Bilibili links stay as plain text in notes, with no cover, duration, stats or UP-owner information shown in place.

relations.evidence: Paste a Bilibili link, get a beautiful card

summary: Renders Bilibili video and UP-owner cards in notes from pasted links, as single cards or auto-laid-out galleries with covers and stats.
